# Just End Portal 1.1.0

Feature update for Minecraft 26.1.2 with NeoForge.

## Highlights

- Redesigned custom portals as one-way portals with dedicated arrival platforms.
- Players can now own one outgoing portal in the Overworld and one outgoing portal in the End independently.
- Placing an awaiting-link End Portal Generator now creates a custom arrival-platform cell instead of a return portal.
- Expanding an outgoing portal expands its arrival platform with the same relative 1:1 footprint, up to the existing 3 × 3 limit.
- Arrival platforms use a floating crying-obsidian half-block visual while retaining a full-block collision box.
- Entering a portal restores the corresponding arrival platform and clears the three blocks directly above each platform cell, with normal item drops.
- Portal travel now preserves entity movement velocity and entry rotation in both directions.
- Animals, falling blocks, and other vanilla portal-compatible entities use the same arrival preparation behavior.
- Placement feedback now reports the exact required dimension and distinguishes between an already-linked portal and an already-installed generator.
- The mod ID remains `njw_just_end_portal`.

## Development

- Added separate development client identities for multiplayer testing.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.1.2
- NeoForge 26.1.2.97
